newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indesen, Sunkyong in venture.
newsitem.headline: Indesen, Sunkyong in venture.

text.p: Indesen Industries Co Ltd and Sunkyong Ltd's wholly-owned SKC Ltd have agreed to inject capital into a VHS video cassette joint venture in China, Indesen said on Wednesday.
Indesen would inject HK$13.91 million and SKC would inject HK$20.87 million into Indesen (Fujian) Magnetics Co Ltd, Indesen Industries said in a statement.
The joint venture would use the capital to buy an automatic production line, injection machines and moulds from SKC to increase its production capacity by about 100 percent, the statement said.
On completion of the deal, SKC's stake in the joint venture would increase to 43.9 percent from 35.3 percent, while Indesen Industres' stake would be reduced to 56.1 percent from 64.7 percent.
SKC is a major raw materials supplier for Indesen Industries' VHS video cassettes and a major customer for its finished products, the statement said.
